name: Player Event Log
description:
Writes the local player's state changes and movements (damage, death, healing, effects, water, lava, fire, freezing, dimension changes, walking, jumping, sneaking, swinging, mining) to logs/player-events.jsonl, one JSON object per line. Read only: no network, no gameplay changes.
